components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for bookings, reservations, and form submissions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0058bc; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004899; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Vehicle Status Badge
components.description: Status badge indicating vehicle availability with high WCAG contrast.
components.css: .ds-badge-available { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Form Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #0b1c30; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0058bc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 88, 188, 0.15); }

narrative.overview: Indrasari Rental Car bridges executive automotive precision with accessible Indonesian rental operations. The visual system pairs structured operational data density with crisp, modern typography and calibrated dual-theme contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Strict WCAG AA/AAA Contrast Hierarchy for both Light (#f8f9ff / #ffffff) and Dark (#0b1c30 / #112038) surfaces.
Accessible Typography & Input States: Placeholders (#64748b, 4.6:1) and secondary metadata (#334155, 9.8:1).
Operational Availability Badges: High-contrast semantic chips (Tersedia, Sedang Disewa, Perawatan).
Mobile-first Responsiveness: Balances on-the-go customer bookings and desktop admin operations.

rules.name: The 4.5:1 Minimum Contrast Rule
rules.body: All body text, input placeholders, metadata labels, and interactive icons must maintain at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background.

rules.name: The Availability Color Rule
rules.body: Emerald green is strictly reserved for available vehicles, active healthy rentals, and confirmed financial returns.

rules.name: The Currency Formatting Rule
rules.body: All monetary figures must be explicitly formatted in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp 450.000 / hari) with consistent tabular figures.

rules.name: The Structural Border Rule
rules.body: Cards and table containers must use a crisp 1px border meeting WCAG 3:1 non-text contrast.

dos: Do format all currency in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp 350.000 / hari) with Indonesian thousand separators (.).
Do validate and format customer Indonesian credentials (SIM A, Nomor HP +62 / 08xx, Alamat) with clear accessible feedback.
Do provide immediate duration and total price calculation as soon as start and end dates are picked.
Do maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast for all text (including placeholders and metadata) and 3:1 for borders.
Do support instant theme switching between Light and Dark mode while preserving high contrast.
donts: Don't use faint placeholders or metadata tokens (#c1c6d6) that fail WCAG contrast on light surfaces.
Don't use cluttered legacy tables with raw data dumps and no sorting/filtering hierarchy.
Don't use decorative gradient text or glassmorphic blur filters that impair readability.
Don't create complicated multi-step booking flows that require repetitive data re-entry.
Don't use side-stripe colored accent borders on cards or alerts.
